bio.text: Abdul El-Sayed is the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Michigan in 2026, after advancing from the August 4 primary.

He is a Michigan native who earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Michigan in 2007, a doctorate from the University of Oxford in 2011 and a medical degree from Columbia University in 2014.
He managed the Detroit health department from 2015 to 2017 and was director and health officer of the Wayne County Department of Health, Human and Veterans Services from 2022 to 2025.
